problem.symptom: Google OAuth retry could still land on state_mismatch after earlier apex/cookie-forwarding fixes.
problem.probableCause: A stale domain-scoped __Secure-better-auth.state cookie can coexist with the fresh host-scoped state cookie and be selected on the callback request.

liveMitigations.ruleName: Clear stale Better Auth OAuth state on retry
liveMitigations.match: Hostname equals archestimator.com and URI Path equals / and URI Query String contains error=state_mismatch
liveMitigations.scopeNote: The rule is intentionally narrowed to the root retry-error URL so it does not clear freshly minted state cookies on normal login/signup traffic.

liveMitigations.behavior: Preserve the original callback request, rewrite only the Cookie header when a Better Auth state cookie matches the callback state, and forward to the main app Worker through a service binding.

sourceFixPrepared.reasonNotLive: Full archestimator-proof Worker script upload/version creation continues to stall or fail at Cloudflare upload/deployment endpoints.
behavior: Clear Better Auth OAuth state cookie variants before forwarding a fresh sign-in state cookie.
Normalize duplicate Better Auth OAuth state cookies on the Google callback request so the cookie matching the callback state is evaluated last.
Map Better Auth state_mismatch to a session-expired login retry message.
Send Better Auth OAuth callback errors back to the login surface instead of a generic root error URL.
